title: ActivityActual
description: Verified actual progress for one activity. Only match verification and planner correction write this row. A separate aggregate from match proposals on purpose: no cascade from a proposal may reach an actual.

sourceVerificationId.description: The Verification whose application produced this row. Null is never allowed here; an actual without provenance is a defect.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency. Clients send the version they read as expectedActivityVersion.
